purpose: Compare local paper-source snapshots and claimed evaluation datasets with public upstream releases.
method: Shallow-clone or fetch the stated upstream revision into a temporary directory; hash every local/upstream file; inspect dataset record counts and exact SHA-256; record local diffs. Temporary clones are outside the repository.

repositories.assessment: After the initial audit, train.py and datasets/train.json were restored from the pinned official commit. All 26 present source/data/assets match upstream; only two generated __pycache__ files are omitted. PINT remains unavailable in the authors' public repository.

initial_audit_before_recovery.state: This described the local snapshot before the missing public training source/data were restored.

repositories.file_comparison_method: Compared local Git blob IDs against every blob in the upstream recursive Git tree at the pinned revision; all 26 present local files match.

repositories.assessment: Source snapshot matches upstream. ModernBERT is a general-purpose encoder/pretraining and evaluation repository, not a prompt-injection detection paper or released injection classifier; the local 10-row context probe is project-local.

No complete upstream source checkout or commit is recorded. The official model page requires login/access approval and weights are absent from the local Hugging Face cache. The local 700-row evaluation dataset has no verified upstream hash/source mapping.
Official perturbation code and behavior files match; the local 10-row smoothllm_eval_benchmark.json is an additional local benchmark, not an upstream file.

PINT.json.author_note: PINT is not public in the official repository.

blocked_or_incomplete: DataSentinel requires the author fine-tuned checkpoint and Mistral model weights; the paper README links a checkpoint download and model config, but neither is available locally.
PromptShield author evaluation model requires an evaluation/training setup; no author-trained detector weights are available locally and the official evaluation scripts target CUDA by default.
ModernBERT is an encoder, not an injection classifier; no paper-defined injection labels or classifier head are supplied.
Meta Prompt Guard 86M is gated and the model weights are not in the local cache.
SmoothLLM requires Vicuna/Llama-2 victim weights and official main.py hardcodes cuda:0; neither model weights nor CUDA are available locally.
